items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Well I met Walter just a little before he died.

ctx.x: clarinet and sax. I think he was killed in an auto accident. That's right.

Run over or something. Those were, I can remember a picture with Brundy, instead of having the rods tuned where it was with the rope. And the ropes, the little ears, some people got a little leather ears. That's right. That's what they used to in the bass drum.
Remember, did your father ever use one of those? I can't remember him with those. Probably had the most modern equipment. He did. I must say, he always kept the most modern
